verdict.rationale: Stream encoding and latency are a fair axis for a remote-desktop product like TeamViewer, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of hardware encoding, codecs, frame rates, or latency suitable for interactive work. Community remarks such as "works very well" are generic and do not address encoding or latency, so they do not establish the capability.

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing
